name: Hollow
body:
The hollow began as an attempt to grant the aberrant power of doppelgangers to flesh golems so that they could blend in better with humanoid societies. The experiment was both a resounding success and a catastrophic failure. The hollows’ creators never intended to also grant their creations the means of imprinting one’s mind, but by the time it was discovered, the hollow had already gained sentience and devised a plan to take over production of their own kind. Worse, the individual who learned of the nefarious plot found only more hollows wherever he tried to warn anybody of their subtle invasion. His only option was to lock himself and the monsters he helped create in an extradimensional space.

A century or two later, and the barrier protecting reality from the hollow has grown weak, but most hollows are unaware of this, and those who break free haven’t bothered going back to tell their kin. Two factions of hollows have risen in that time: The stronger, more monstrous hollows, and those who adapted better to living as humanoids. The former hunts the latter to demonstrate their superiority, while the latter wants to seamlessly integrate as their creators originally wanted and must strike down their feral brethren to preserve their secret. Whispers persist within sapiate circles that their creator has survived, hidden away, still trying to find ways to destroy them and turning them against each other.

Physical Description: In their base form, hollows are gaunt amalgamations of flesh and bone, but using their gifts, they can replicate any humanoid from which they can get a sample and a chance to draw on its experiences and memories. Most are content to do this using hair, but blood and other parts of the body can be equally viable options.

Base Height	Base Weight	Weight Modifier	Modifier
7 ft. 3 in.	130 lbs.	2d8	x3 lbs.
Aging Effects
Adult	Middle Age	Old	Venerable	Maximum Age
5	70	135	200	+6d10 years
Society

Sapiate hollows avoid congregating in too large of groups, and will often run each other off if they feel like one’s presence could threaten their delicate position in the towns and cities they call home. Animates, however, might form gangs or packs, and are usually willing to sacrifice others to protect themselves from being exposed.

Relations: Hollows’ emotions are gained through the mental links they form with the humanoids they become. Young hollows learn how to utilize those feelings well enough to make them seem genuine, so one knows to cry when something sad happens, or how to demonstrate satisfaction at a job well done. There are currently no documented instances of a hollow developing a personality outside of stealing and adapting others’.

Alignment and Religion: Like it’s body, a hollow’s alignment is a blend of the minds it has touched. Animate hollows are more likely to develop a sense of religion than sapiates, who try to remain agnostic and not draw the ire of divine beings who could out them.

Adventurers: Working so closely with others can assail a hollow’s mind with intrusive thoughts, and it takes a firm grasp of their mental talents to avoid blurting out what somebody else is thinking because while some find it endearing to work with like-minded individuals, a number of adventurers are paranoid and wary enough to wonder how the hollow always seems to know what they’re thinking.

Hollow Names: Some hollows take on the full life of the individuals they mimic, name and all. Others hold onto a cross section of personalities from which they shape a fitting name. Animates, particularly the more dangerous ones, might refer to themselves and others by a prominent feature of their physical form or personality.

Example Names: Bones, Claw, Drone, Halcyon, Joy, Juniper, Legs, Somber, Socket

Hollow Ancestry Traits

All hollows share the following traits.

Ability Score Modifiers: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, –2 Constitution. A hollow’s base form is powerful, but frail. They have an unnatural insight thanks in part to their mental talents.
Speed: A hollow’s base movement is 30 feet.
Size: Medium. A hollow’s size grants no bonuses or penalties.
Type: Hollows are aberrations that take humanoid forms to hide what they truly are. They can be affected by abilities and spells that target either, such as hold person or a ranger’s favored enemy. They also have the shapechanger subtype.
Senses: Darkvision Hollows have darkvision out to 60 feet.
Heritage: While young, hollows develop a heritage based on the others around them and the life they lived growing up. Choose animate, lancian, sapiate. Once this choice is made, it can’t be changed.
Steal Form (Su): A hollow can cast alter self at will, but must have a small piece of the creature it wishes to become, such as a vial of blood or hair.
Scattered Thoughts (Su): Hollows have a constant detect thoughts effect that they can’t control. Any humanoid within 60 feet of a hollow for at least 3 rounds automatically attempts a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the hollow’s character level + its Wisdom modifier) to avoid having its thoughts read in this way. Because this ability is instinctual, creatures that make their save against it are not immediately aware they did unless they succeed by 5 or more, and being aware does not immediately reveal the source of the divination by itself. A creature that saves against the effect doesn’t have to save against the same hollow’s detect thoughts again for 24 hours.
Languages: Hollows begin play speaking Common and one other language of their choice. Hollows with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages associated with the humanoid form they take most often.
Animate Heritage Traits
Animalistic: Animate hollows always treat Intimidate and Survival as class skills, and they gain a +2 racial bonus to one of those skills of their choice. Once this choice is made, it can’t be changed.
Reaching Form: When in their base forms, animates gain Lunge as a bonus feat, even if they don’t meet the prerequisites. When they meet the prerequisites, they can use that feat even in their stolen form.
Slam: Animate hollows gain a natural slam attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage (1d3 Small, 1d6 Large). This can be used as a primary natural attack, or an offhand attack if the hollow is also wielding a manufactured weapon.
Lancian Heritage Traits

Lancian hollows are named for their creator who they believe still lives somewhere hidden in their demiplane. Taking a cue from those who constructed them initially, these hollows have modified their flesh golem bodies to accept unusual and extraplanar materials. At 1st level, a lancian hollow can use steal form to cast animal aspect, provided it has a piece of the listed creature (or a reasonable alternate dtermined by the GM). Beginning at 6th level, a lancian hollow can use steal form to cast greater animal aspect and polymorph spells such as beast shape I and monstrous physique I as if it was a sorcerer of its character level. It must still have a piece of the creature it wishes to become.

Sapiate Heritage Traits
Blend: Sapiate hollows always treat Bluff and Diplomacy as class skills, and they gain a +2 racial bonus to one of those skills of their choice. Once this choice is made, it can’t be changed.
Collected Thoughts: After a sapiate interacts with one specific humanoid for at least 3 rounds, it can focus its detect thoughts effect on that creature alone until it moves at least 60 feet away. Sapiates with allies who trust them will often use this on one ally in the morning to keep their scattered thoughts from drawing too much attention to them.
Societal: Each sapiate begins play with one vigilante social talent of its choice. If that talent requires a vigilante level higher than 1st, the sapiate gains it automatically once her character level meets that requirement.
Alternate Ancestry Traits
Constructed Origins: Years of separation from the world caused some hollows to partially revert back into flesh golems, making it harder to maintain multiple forms. They have a single humanoid form they can take other than their base form. They also gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue. This trait replaces steal form.
Hollow Favored Class Bonuses

Hollows can choose any favored class bonuses associated with the humanoid form they take most often.
